reasoning: A universally recognized icon for a muted, disabled, or non-working microphone. While originally a UI state toggle, in a task list it cleanly represents tasks about troubleshooting dead mics, locking down voice/listening privacy permissions, or configuring mute controls, though it must not be confused with an active microphone (recording) or muted speaker (sound output).
